$ python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
paths=[p/'checkpoint.json',p/'provider.json']
before={x.name:hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for x in paths}
r=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing','advance',*[str(x) for x in paths]],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(r.stdout)
print(r.stderr)
print('exit_code:',r.returncode)
print('input_sha256:',before)
print('supplied_input_bytes_unchanged:', all(hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before[x.name] for x in paths))
PY
